FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Fresh Fields Grocery operates as a retail grocery store specializing in a wide variety of food products, including fresh produce, meats, dairy, canned goods, and frozen items. With a spacious layout of over 3,000 square feet, we prioritize customer convenience and accessibility, maintaining compliance with all local and federal food safety regulations. Our dedicated team undergoes regular food safety training to ensure that we uphold high standards of cleanliness and proper food handling procedures. In addition, we have a well-established inventory management system that helps minimize spoilage and ensures the availability of quality products for our customers. Our store also implements effective pest control and sanitation programs to maintain a clean shopping environment, coupled with established emergency procedures to safeguard staff and customers. Fresh Fields Grocery is committed to providing fresh, high-quality food while creating a safe and welcoming atmosphere for the community.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not accept stores with unresolved or repeated food safety violations and confirms that all operations are in full compliance with food safety standards. We do not engage with businesses that have unmonitored or unregistered underground storage tanks, and we ensure that extensive on-site cooking is equipped with proper fire suppression systems. Additionally, all employees undergo documented food safety training, affirming our commitment to maintaining a safe and compliant environment.
